```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = 0.6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```


Load weather data
```{r}
data("weather_df")

weather_df =
  weather_df |> 
  mutate(
    month = lubridate::floor_date(date, unit = "month")
  )

# floor date rounds all date values down to the first of the month. Ex: august 5th becomes august 1st
```

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  filter(prcp>0) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=prcp))+
  geom_histogram()
```
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  filter(tmax >= 20, tmax <= 30) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=tmax, y = tmin, color = name, shape = name))+
  geom_point()

```

## 'group_by()'

add some groups!
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  group_by(name, month)
```

## summarize

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  group_by(name, month) |> 
  summarise(count = n())
```

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  count(name, month)
```

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  group_by(month) |> 
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    n_days = n_distinct(date))
```

Dont do this
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  pull(tmax) |> 
  summary()
```

Do this instead
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  group_by(name) |> 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_tmax = median(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_prcp = sd(prcp, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_prcp = quantile(prcp, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q95_prcp = quantile(prcp, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits=2)
```

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  group_by(name, month) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = name,
    values_from = mean_tmax
  ) |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

# na.rm = TRUE exludes missing data
```

what about looking at this
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  group_by(name, month) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = mean_tmax, color = name))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()
```
